g.text: Which way of choosing a 2027 plan costs people least

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: 758 held-out MEPS adults, each run through 3 real 2027 employer menus (WA PEBB, OR PEBB, Tennessee) with their actual 2024 care.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: Regret = what they paid minus the cheapest plan. Lines are 95% household-bootstrap intervals.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: Lowest premium beat TabPFN by $15 mean regret per person (95% CI $7 to $24); TabPFN beat same-as-last-year by $28 ($12 to $45).

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #898781

g.text: Off scale, not drawn: lowest deductible mean regret per person $1,078; lowest deductible 90th-percentile regret $1,912. Source: eval/results/step4_decision.json (make eval-decision); approximations are listed in the JSON.
